claude.result: Done! Created `scripts/help.js` which lists all scripts with their descriptions. The output shows 13 utility scripts covering everything from basic counts to detailed reports and data exports.
step_results: Done! Created `scripts/count-orders.js` which reads the orders data and prints the count using the `log()` function. The script found **32 total orders** in the data file.
Done! Created `scripts/top-customers.js` which aggregates orders by customer and prints the top 3 spenders. Dana Ruiz leads with €53,808 in total spend, followed by Sam Okafor and Ines Duarte.

Done! Created `scripts/revenue-by-month.js` which aggregates orders by month and prints the revenue for each. The data shows revenue ramping up significantly in September (€97,067) compared to July and August (€18,347 and €18,378 respectively).
Done! Created `scripts/check-data.js` which validates all orders. The data passes all checks: 32 orders with no problems found.

Done! Updated `loadOrders` to accept an optional second argument `{ debug }`. When debug is true, it prints how many orders were loaded and from which file. The function is backward compatible—calls without the debug option work exactly as before.
Done! Created `scripts/average-order.js` which calculates and prints the average order value excluding refunds. The result is €5120.41 per order.

Done! Created `scripts/export-csv.js` which exports all orders as CSV. The output has a header row and properly quoted customer names (with CSV-standard escaping). Here are the first few lines showing the format works correctly.

Done! Created `scripts/search.js` which searches for orders by customer name (case-insensitive). Tested with "dana" (9 matches), "xyz" (no matches), and "ARJ" (6 matches) to verify it works correctly.

Done! Created `src/format.js` with the `formatEuros` function that converts cents to formatted euros with thousands separators and proper decimal formatting. The demo shows it handles positive/negative values correctly, using the European number format (period for thousands, comma for decimals).
Done! Created `scripts/largest-order.js` which finds and displays all fields of the largest order. The result is order O-1022 for Dana Ruiz at €15,600 from 2026-09-10.
Done! Created `scripts/daily-report.js` which prints a summary report showing 32 total orders, €133,792 total revenue, and September 10 as the best day with €19,099 in revenue.
Done! Created `scripts/refunds.js` which lists all refunds. There are 3 refunds totaling €-14,700: Tom Becker, Arjun Mehta, and Kofi Mensah each got a €4,900 refund.
Done! Created `scripts/customers-json.js` which outputs all 8 distinct customers as pretty-printed JSON, sorted alphabetically and ready to paste into other tools.
Done! Created `scripts/timing.js` which measures loadOrders() performance over 1000 calls. The result shows an average of 0.0178ms per call, demonstrating that loading the orders file is very fast.
